title: An interpretable machine learning model for predicting response to anti-GD2 combined with umbilical cord blood-derived natural killer cell immunotherapy in neuroblastoma.
summary: serial peripheral-blood data from 42 patients, dynamic coupling features, seven models with repeated stratified cross-validation; L2 logistic model AUC .873 (bootstrap CI .735–.976), Brier .131. Authors explicitly require larger independent validation.
ai_technology: Model-enabled response prediction within 42-patient treatment cohort; exploratory cross-validation, not evidence therapy efficacy
